gate_a_calibration.methodology: Full-sample OOS calibration on all 380 holdout matches across 3 markets.

gate_b_market_alpha.methodology: Proxy CLV benchmarked against Power De-Vigged Pinnacle closing total line.

gate_c_economics.methodology: Hypothetical retail backtest using opening consensus pricing with 6.5% overround.

governance_rationale: FAIL_CLOSED_BLOCKED: Calibration (Gate A) and economic yield (Gate C) were verified, but the strategy failed to overcome retail bookmaker overround relative to Pinnacle closing lines (Gate B). Live capital allocation is permanently halted pursuant to fail-closed safety protocol.
